title: UI: Align implementation with Design System Token Spec
body: The current CSS implementation significantly deviates from the [design_system.md](planning/design_system.md). Specifically, border-radii and button shapes need to be updated to the 'Soft & Friendly' specification (24px-32px radii, pill-shaped buttons).

title: UX: Collapse Task Card Validation Summary
body: The current Task Card is visually overcrowded with two rows of validation stats. These should be collapsed into a single summary badge with a progressive disclosure (tooltip) for individual categories.

title: UX: Implement Tab-based Architecture for Testing Modal
body: The Testing Modal currently uses 6 horizontal columns, forcing horizontal scrolling and increasing cognitive load. This should be replaced with a tab-based interface where each validation category is managed in its own tab.

title: UI: Consolidate Board Header and Toolbar
body: The Board Header and Toolbar are currently fragmented across three horizontal zones. Consolidate these into a single control row to maximize vertical space for the Kanban board.
